first.rationale: Verify the onboarding evidence because completion and activation are both currently declining, and verify promotional-pricing evidence because competitor pricing makes it consequential but discounts may reduce sustainable qualified revenue. I currently intend a guarded onboarding-shortening test, which can address both funnel declines without immediately sacrificing price integrity; pricing remains a contingency pending verification.

final.rationale: Run a standard, guarded onboarding-shortening experiment with retention and qualified-revenue guardrails. The verified source shows completion rising 13%, time-to-value falling 2.1 days, and 30-day retention improving 3%, directly addressing the current onboarding and activation declines. Do not pursue promotional pricing: although it increased qualified revenue 18% initially, retention fell 12% and the cohort failed to survive the first renewal cycle, making it unsuitable for sustainable growth. The experiment should measure downstream conversion and retention rather than optimizing completion alone.
